svg.title: Jesus and Women
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (Luke 8:1-3): Jesus walks a hill road with two of the Twelve ahead of Him and three women following, Mary Magdalene among them. Caption: "Through the towns of Galilee, preaching the kingdom." Luke says: "the twelve were with him, and also some women". Panel 2 (Luke 10:38-42): Jesus seated teaching, Mary seated on the floor at His feet listening, Martha standing behind pointing at her sister. Caption: "Bethany: Mary sits at His feet." Martha says: "Lord, do you not care that my sister has left me to serve alone?" Jesus says: "Mary has chosen the good portion, which will not be taken away from her." Note: "At a teacher’s feet: the disciple’s place (Acts 22:3)." Panel 3 (Mark 15:40-41): three empty crosses on a rise at dusk; three women watch from a distance, Mary Magdalene among them. Caption: "At the cross, the women stayed." Mark says: "When he was in Galilee, they followed him and ministered to him". Panel 4 (John 20:15-17): the open tomb behind; Mary Magdalene kneels before the risen Jesus, who stands in radiant light. Jesus says: "go to my brothers and say to them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’" Panel 5 (John 20:18): Mary Magdalene stands in a room before three seated disciples, her arm raised as she tells them. Caption: "She went and told them." Mary Magdalene says: "I have seen the Lord". Note: "Earlier, Mary Magdalene and the women told the apostles of the empty tomb, and “these words seemed to them an idle tale” (Luke 24:10-11)." The point: Jesus taught women as His disciples and sent them as the first witnesses of His resurrection. Sit at His feet, and go and tell what you have seen (Luke 10:42; John 20:17-18).
svg.text: Disciples at His feet, witnesses of His rising
